title: xscale
summary: Query or set the X-axis scale for the current axes or a specified axes handle.
description: `xscale` controls whether the X axis is displayed on a linear or logarithmic scale. It supports query, explicit scale assignment, command-form style string arguments, and explicit axes-target forms.

arguments.name: scale
arguments.description: Scale value to apply to the X axis.

arguments.name: ax
arguments.description: Target axes handle. If omitted, the current axes are used.

examples.description: Switch the X axis to logarithmic scale
Apply scale to a specific subplot
examples.output: % Only the target axes receives logarithmic X scaling

notes: `xscale` shares state with the axes `XScale` property, so `set(gca, 'XScale', 'log')` and `xscale('log')` are equivalent.
Passing an explicit axes handle updates that axes without changing the current axes selection.
gpu_residency: `xscale` reads and writes axes metadata. The renderer applies log mapping in its direct GPU coordinate path without gathering GPU-resident plot data.
